events.preShowWeatherTimeline: Thur 6/30 2:30pm EDT - Increasing heat and humidity and 90F at 5pm. West winds 10-15mph and gusty. events.showForecast: Thur 6/30 2:30pm EDT - A sultry 86F at showtime with light west winds near 10mph. Temperatures likely hold in the 80s throughout the show window. Widely scattered lightning storms are possible during the show with an approaching cool front. Heavy downpours and gusty winds to 25-30mph will be associated with any storm that develops. The inbound front could also result in changing wind speeds and wind directions. We will attempt to pin this timing down for posting in the Band app on show day.

events.weatherPlanning:
Thur 6/30 2:30pm EDT -

Heat Risk - Will be moderate through the "lot" period and into the performance window due to sun, humidity and light winds. Hydrate!


Lightning Risk - Scattered lightning storms will be possible from 2-5pm, then again during the show window, possibly extending into the early morning hours. We will be monitoring!


Heavy Rain - Any lightning storm impacting the venue could bring brief heavy downpours.


Wind - Although winds will be strong during the afternoon (gusting to 20mph), winds will die down during the show. Exception: Winds could gust 25-30mph in the vicinity of any lightning storm and could be quite variable associated with the approaching cool front.

events.notesGeneral:
LINEUP/SCHEDULE CHANGE:
The MidCal Champions Showcase DCI Tour event regrets to announce the SoundSport® and Open Class corps performances will not take place at this event as a result of weather advisories for extreme heat which are projected for Friday, July 5 in Clovis. This difficult decision was made in consultation with the corps with the safety of our spectators and participants in mind.
 
In an effort to mitigate some of the effects of the forecasted extreme heat, the gates for the event will now open at 7:30 p.m. PT, with the first performing corps scheduled to step off after sunset.
 
We understand the disappointment this may cause and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We encourage fans to attend other California shows featuring the talented Open Class and SoundSport groups between July 6 and July 14.
 
View upcoming California events
 

General Information
Parking:
Spectator Parking – Spectator parking will be located in the parking lot west of the stadium off Barstow Avenue. Parking is $10 per vehicle and is CASH ONLY.
Spectator Entrances:
Entrance – Spectator entry will be located on the north side of the stadium.
Spectator Re-Entry – Spectator re-entry will be located on the north side of the stadium and will require a ticket and hand stamp.
Concessions:
Concessions will be available behind the main grandstand.
Souvenirs:
The DCI Festival Marketplace will be located behind the main grandstand.
 

Important Weather Information
With excessive heat warnings and advisories in place across the West Coast please note this important information regarding the MidCal Champions Showcase show.

events.anticipatedWeatherRisks:
AGAIN - HEAT. Posting this early as forecast confidence is HIGH.


High temps projected around 106 in the afternoon. NWS will likely put out an Excessive Heat Warning which is as high as it gets on the heat warning system.


WBGT in the afternoon will hit the upper 80s which is HIGH and approaching Extreme. Luckily air is dry with dewpoints in the 50s.


Hot, dry Texas wind blows 15-20 mph on the day and into the evening under mostly clear skies.


Heat illness is the main risk. Precipitation not a factor. Sun exposure should also be mitigated with a full day of sun planned.


Please void any bare feet. (People & pets) Pavement temps will be around 150 and if we have full sun, it's not out of the question to hit 170 on the IR thermometer on artificial turf. Laying on turf for any performance moves during rehearsal not suggested in the afternoon.


Not only people can overheat but please take steps to shade and/or cool electronics and gear such as tablets or laptops and phones.


--Spencer Adkins Meteorologist

events.name: The DCI Celebration Countdown Cinema Event
events.notesGeneral:
Following a one-year hiatus, this special one-night event features amazing sights and sounds from five of the nation’s top Drum Corps International ensembles, including iconic DCI World Championship performances from Fort Mill, SC’s Carolina Crown’s Inferno (2015); Rosemont, IL’s The Cavaliers’ Propaganda (2016), Concord, CA’s Blue Devils’ Metamorph (2017); Santa Clara, CA’s Santa Clara Vanguard’s (2018) Babylon; and Canton, OH’s Bluecoats The Bluecoats 2019). 

Additionally, interspersed between the performances, attendees will see live spots with broadcast hosts from the spring training site of the Bluecoats, in addition to pre-recorded up-to-the-moment rehearsal camp updates from several other groups that will appear at DCI events this August at Indianapolis’ Lucas Oil Stadium.
events.notesIndividualTickets: Tickets are available at over 700 cinemas in the United States. Prices vary by location. We regret that international viewing will be unavailable due to audio rights.
events.groupTicketsDisclaimer: Group tickets are not available for this event.

events.name: DCI Celebration Fan Cut Outs
events.notesGeneral:
After a year off and in the wake of the cancelation of the 2020 DCI Tour, Drum Corps International is set to return to Indianapolis' Lucas Oil Stadium August 12–14. Nearly two dozen corps will have the unique opportunity to showcase their performances – perhaps unlike at any other time in DCI history!

You can take part in the celebration, even if you can’t join us in-person at Lucas Oil Stadium this August! For a donation of $100 to DCI’s ongoing programs, your supplied photographic image will be reproduced as a life-size DCI Fan Cut Out that will be placed in Lucas Oil Stadium during DCI's Celebration Events. This is a unique and unprecedented opportunity for loyal fans, family, and even cherished pets to be “in the audience” for this once in a lifetime three-day event!

events.notesGeneral:
Drum Corps International has partnered with Music For All and Downtown Indy, Inc. to bring a family-focused community gathering to the heart of Indianapolis to celebrate music education and teachers, and the importance they play in our lives. Shining a Light on Music Education is an event featuring an evening of live ensembles both locally and from around the globe, coming together on Monument Circle from 5pm to dark on Friday, August 11th . The event will culminate in a salute to Indianapolis History with the Shining a Light production shown nightly on Monument Circle.

This event will be a family-friendly festival-like atmosphere with some of Indianapolis’ best food vendors onsite and entertainment aplenty. As well, percussive units from DCI’s DrumLine Battle division, SoundSport ensembles, and the INpact Band, an ensemble bringing together middle school music students from across the state each summer, will share the spotlight.

The annual SoundSport International Music & Food Festival celebrates international music making and the international growth and reach that Drum Corps International has developed over more than 50 years. With Entertainment, food trucks, drink tents, interactive displays and activities, and local vendor booths, this event is a must see for Drum Corps fans, local residents, and visitors.
